transport.residual_orientation: stored direction for j_e=0 and reversed direction for j_e=1
transport.path_rule: shortest length, left-to-right before right-to-left, then lexicographic edge and vertex sequences

exact_obstruction.statement: For the all-zero current, every residual crossing consists only of 0-to-1 flips and has length at least L-1. Therefore any residual-crossing flip has reciprocal weight distortion at least max((p/(1-p))^(L-1),((1-p)/p)^(L-1)).
exact_obstruction.consequence: No residual-path flip can have a size-uniform two-sided action-distortion bound at fixed p!=1/2, independent of path-selection rule.
exact_obstruction.midpoint_boundary: At p=1/2 action distortion is exactly one, but a size-uniform inverse-multiplicity bound remains unproved; this deterministic rule has maxima 3 and 8 at L3 and L4.

decision: Close size-uniform residual-path coupling away from p=1/2. At the midpoint, isolate inverse multiplicity as the only remaining gate for this transport class; do not tune the registered path order after the result.
claim_boundary: The exact obstruction applies to two-sided bounded action distortion for residual-path flips. It does not rule out weighted many-to-one transport, a midpoint entropy argument, or a different global proof of decoding.
